The company demonstrates robust profitability with a high operating margin of 32% and significant scale ($20.9 billion quarterly revenue, over $300 billion in total assets). However, its highly leveraged balance sheet (total liabilities of $274.9 billion compared to $34 billion in equity) and very weak current ratio (0.35) constrain its credit profile to the mid-to-lower investment grade range.

DECISION: BBB+
